name: Centre Zen de la Falaise Verte
reason: No contact route: falaiseverte.org's contact page (linked as /?pagename=contact from the site header) shows only a phone number (+33 4 75 85 10 39) and postal address in Saint-Laurent-du-Pape, Ardèche; no email and no form on the home, contact, access, centre, zen, sesshin or resources pages. The channel is also thin: 14 uploads (531 subscribers), mostly archival 15-minute talks by founder Taikan Jyoji uploaded in 2020–21, and only 3 uploads since 2022 (two recorded morning zazen sessions and a jukai clip), although the description says the Tuesday morning zazen is streamed most weeks. Rinzai temple (Myōshin-ji), founded 1987; sesshin are 70 € a day. Owner may revisit if the Tuesday streams are kept as uploads or an email is published.
